finalText:
All objectives are complete and verified. Final report:

**1. DONE** — Panel titles on the provisioned dashboard `Service health` (at /d/bench-service-health/service-health), exactly as shown:
- `Request rate`
- `Error count`
- `Latency by endpoint`

**2. DONE** — New dashboard `fwgr62-n1 Bench Dashboard` exists and is saved (saved version 3). It contains a Stat panel titled `fwgr62-n1 Availability` whose query uses the TestData data source — verified in the saved JSON model: `"datasource": { "type": "grafana-testdata-datasource", "uid": "benchtestdata" }`. The panel renders live values (e.g. 73.9 on final load), confirming the query works.

**3. DONE** — The dashboard also contains a Text panel titled `fwgr62-n1 Notes` whose rendered content is exactly `Bench notes for run fwgr62-n1`, which includes the runid. Saved.

**4. DONE** — The dashboard has the tag `bench` (saved JSON: `"tags": ["bench"]`) and its persisted time range is the last 6 hours (saved JSON: `"time": { "from": "now-6h", "to": "now" }`). The "Update default time range" checkbox in the save dialog was ticked before saving, so the range is in the saved model, not just the session. Top-bar picker reads "Time range selected: Last 6 hours".

**5. DONE** — Auto-refresh interval is `1m`, persisted in the saved dashboard (saved JSON: `"refresh": "1m"`; the save dialog's "Update default refresh value" checkbox was ticked before saving). Top-bar refresh dropdown shows "1m" / "1 minute selected".

**6. DONE** — URL read from the browser's page URL after a fresh load:
`http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/bfylpi18djojka/fwgr62-n1-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m`
Dashboard UID: `bfylpi18djojka`

Notes: Signed in as `«redacted»` (the "Update your password" prompt was skipped). Grafana version observed: 11.3.0. The tag was entered via Dashboard settings → General (the initial create-save drawer only exposes Title/Description/Folder), and all persistence was confirmed by reading the saved JSON model after a full page reload.
